preferences: I like bright, fruit-forward light roasts. Espresso: 18g in, 45-54g out, 30-40s, 8 bar, 10s preinfusion at 2-3 bar, IMS 18g High-Flow basket on Acaia Orbit with SSP Lab Sweet V3 burrs. V60: 24g/400g (1:16.7) Hoffmann method, 48g bloom for 45s. AeroPress: 18g/200g inverted.

espresso.notes: At 1.5: vegetal and bitter. 206°F improved flavor. Next: try 1.3 to slow shot and improve extraction.

v60.notes: Decaf may drain faster due to lower bean density. If too quick/thin, go finer to 7.0. Expect mellow chocolate and mild fruit — decaf won't be as vibrant but should be smooth and clean.

aeropress.notes: Inverted method to control steeping. Decaf extracts easily — don't go too fine or steep too long. Aim for a clean, balanced cup.

espresso.notes: At 1.1/206°F: good flavor, no bitterness, but 75s total — too slow. At 1.2/206°F: 52.9g in 50.9s — slightly bitter. Next: try 1.3 or reduce yield to 50g. 208°F available as future lever.

v60.notes: Very dense Chiroso — may need slightly finer grind (7.0) to extract properly. Should produce bright papaya, watermelon, sugarcane, orange spice. Keep water hot — this bean rewards high extraction.

aeropress.notes: Dense bean — longer steep may help. Expect concentrated fruit and sweetness. If sour, extend steep or go finer.

coffees.name: Chocolate Bunnies
coffees.meta: Limited · 50% Brazil Natural · 50% Honduras Natural · Medium Roast

espresso.notes: Medium roast dual-natural blend. Very soluble — start coarser and lower temp. Should be syrupy, chocolatey, low-acid. If flat/muddy go finer; if thin/sharp go coarser or lower temp.

v60.notes: Medium roast naturals extract easily — go slightly coarser and cooler vs. light roasts. Should be chocolatey and sweet with fruit undertones. If bitter/ashy, coarsen or cool water further.

aeropress.notes: Medium roast extracts fast — shorter steep and coarser grind vs. light roasts. Great candidate for AeroPress — should produce thick, chocolatey concentrate.

coffees.name: Finca Momoto — Catitta
coffees.meta: Typica & Caturra · Natural · 1500 masl · Santa Clara, Panama · Limited

espresso.notes: Natural Typica & Caturra from the Hartmann family's Finca Momoto. Expect juicy ripe fruit and syrupy body. More soluble than washed light roasts — start coarser. If flat/muddy go finer to 1.2; if sharp/thin coarsen or drop to 202°F.

v60.notes: Natural process at moderate altitude — slightly coarser and cooler than high-altitude washed coffees. Expect juicy tropical fruit and syrupy sweetness. If flat, go finer; if harsh, cool water down.

aeropress.notes: Natural process should produce a concentrated, fruity AeroPress cup. Moderate steep time — naturals can over-extract quickly. Expect big fruit and body.
